name: Mass Meta Creator AI
author: Mostafij Emon

sections.description:
Mass Meta Creator AI allows you to automatically generate SEO-optimized Meta Titles, Meta Descriptions, and Focus Keywords for your WordPress pages using the power of AI (Google Gemini or OpenAI). It is designed to save hours of manual work by automating the SEO optimization process for bulk pages.

🚀 Who is this plugin for?

This plugin is the perfect solution for:
* SEO Agencies & Professionals: Who need to optimize hundreds of client pages quickly without manual writing.
* Bloggers & Content Creators: Who have a large archive of posts missing proper meta tags.
* Web Developers: Who want to deliver SEO-ready sites to clients without hiring a copywriter.
* Site Owners: Who want to migrate content or update old posts with fresh, AI-generated SEO data.

⚙️ How it Works

  1. Context Awareness: You provide your “Homepage Content” or a brief about your business. The AI uses this to understand your brand voice and niche.
  2. CSV Import: Upload a simple CSV file containing the URLs of the pages you want to optimize.
  3. AI Processing: The plugin sends the URL and your context to the AI (Gemini or OpenAI). The AI analyzes the request and acts as an SEO expert.
  4. Generation: It generates a catchy Meta Title, a click-worthy Meta Description, and a relevant Focus Keyword.
  5. One-Click Update: You can review the generated tags and save them directly to Yoast SEO or Rank Math with a single click.

🔑 API Usage & Key Policy (Important)

  • Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): This plugin acts as a bridge between your WordPress site and the AI providers. We do not provide API keys. You must obtain your own API key from Google (Gemini) or OpenAI.
  • Direct Connection: Your API key is stored securely in your own database. The plugin communicates directly with Google or OpenAI servers. No data passes through our (the developers’) servers.
  • Cost: * Google Gemini: Currently offers a free tier which is sufficient for most users.
    • OpenAI: Requires a paid account with credits.

✨ Features

  • Bulk Generation: Upload a CSV file and generate meta tags for unlimited pages at once.
  • Dual AI Support: Choose between Google Gemini (Recommended for free usage) and OpenAI (GPT).
  • Context Aware: Uses your site’s specific context to generate highly relevant and branded tags.
  • Auto Feature Image: Automatically downloads and sets feature images if image URLs are provided in the CSV.
  • Seamless Integration: Fully compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math plugins.
  • Live Preview: Review AI-generated content before saving it to your live site.

How to Use

Step 1: Configure AI (One Time Setup)
1. Go to Mass Meta Creator AI > API Setup.
2. Select your provider: Google Gemini (Recommended) or OpenAI.
3. Enter your own API Key (Get it from Google AI Studio or OpenAI Dashboard).
4. Click Save Settings and then Check API Status to verify the connection.

Step 2: Set Brand Context
1. Go to Basic Settings.
2. In “Homepage Content”, paste your website’s “About Us” or Homepage text. This helps the AI understand what your site is about.
3. Save Changes.

Step 3: Bulk Generate Meta Tags
1. Go to Bulk Generator tab.
2. Click Download Sample CSV to see the format.
3. Prepare your CSV file with headers: Page URL, Feature Image URL (Optional).
4. Click Import CSV and upload your file.
5. Wait for the AI to process each row.
6. Once statuses show “READY”, click Update Pages to save them to your site.

Additional Information

Service Disclosure & Data Privacy

This plugin relies on external Artificial Intelligence services to generate content. Transparency is our priority:

  • 3rd Party Services: This plugin connects strictly to the Google Gemini API and OpenAI API.
  • Data Transmission: * When you run the generator, the plugin sends prompts containing your “Homepage Context” and the specific “Page URL” to the AI provider.
    • This is necessary for the AI to read your content and generate relevant meta tags.
  • No Intermediary: We (the plugin developers) DO NOT collect, store, track, or see any of your data, API keys, or generated content. The connection is strictly Your Site <-> AI Provider.
  • API Key Responsibility: You are solely responsible for managing your API usage and costs (if any). We do not sell API credits.

Terms of Use: By using this plugin, you agree to the respective AI providers’ terms:
* Google Gemini Terms of Service
* OpenAI Terms of Use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mass-meta-creator-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Mass Meta Creator AI menu in your dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for the plugin?

The plugin itself is free. However, you need your own API key. Google Gemini currently has a free tier. OpenAI requires paid credits.

Can I use this without Yoast or Rank Math?

Currently, the plugin is specifically built to update fields for Yoast SEO and Rank Math.

Does the plugin store my API key?

Yes, but only in your own WordPress database (wp_options table). It is never shared with us.
